turns.text:
**It cannot be determined from the tools/data available here.**

I checked every table and every column in this Human Protein Atlas bulk dataset for anything related to protein half-life (searching for "half", "turnover", "lifetime", "stability", "degradation", "clearance", "metabolic") and found **no such column in any table**, including the main `proteinatlas` table. The HPA bulk files provided here simply do not include a protein half-life / turnover field.

For reference, ALB is present in the dataset, but the only related quantitative fields are blood-concentration values:

| Gene | Gene description | Blood conc. IM [pg/L] | Blood conc. MS [pg/L] |
|------|------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| ALB | Albumin | 40,000,000,000,000 (4×10¹³) | (empty in this extract) |

So, based strictly on these tool results, the protein half-life of ALB is **not available** in the data; it would need to come from an external source.
